game.title: Lantern Line
game.description: Defend seven lanes against ten waves of enemies. Place and upgrade towers, manage your energy, and keep the lanterns burning in this tower-defence strategy game.
game.controls: Select a card, then click or tap a tile. Keys 1–9 select cards; arrows move the tile cursor; Enter places or inspects; Space pauses; G opens the field guide; hold Shift for 5× speed.
